snapshot.title: Time Jump: Drone Reappears Over Fairgrounds — Third Instance

fields.narration: It is now 1:00 PM on Sunday, October 25, 2026. The drone identified as RID-BM-12-004 has returned to the same circular flight pattern over the west grandstand at 320 feet AGL for the third time. The local media, including Channel 10 News, have reported the drone as an active Group aircraft. Social media is now flooded with allegations that the Group is violating the NO FLY day and operating drones over a crowd of 6,000 people. The flight operations desk has not authorized any launch. The GCS remains inactive and must not be used to track or engage the drone. The Incident Commander must now initiate formal coordination with law enforcement and federal authorities under HUOG-ERP Section 8.4.
worldState: The drone has now been observed in the same pattern over the west grandstand for the third time.
Channel 10 News has aired a video from a bystander showing the drone with a red light over the crowd.
The social media post from @HarwickCrowd2026 has been shared 1,200 times and is trending under #DroneOverCrowd.
Harwick Police Command has not yet activated the 'Drone Incident' protocol but is aware of the media coverage.
The Group’s internal communications have not been altered, and no unauthorized data has been released.
The FAA FSDO has been notified via the ASO’s incident report (FIR-2026-1025-1205) and is monitoring the situation.
